subject.title: fix: keep yielded parent runs deferred until subagents settle

question: Should `deferred` become a permanent public cron run status across persistence, Gateway protocol, CLI/UI, hooks, and Plugin SDK, or should yielded waiting remain an internal lifecycle state?
rationale: The runtime bug can be repaired under either design, but source review cannot decide the permanent externally visible compatibility contract.

options.title: Keep waiting internal
options.body: Repair yielded-parent settlement and delivery while preserving the existing public cron status union.

options.title: Adopt public deferred status
options.body: Keep `deferred` across all public consumers with documented semantics and fresh-install plus upgrade compatibility proof.

recommendation.title: Keep waiting internal
recommendation.body: Repair yielded-parent settlement and delivery while preserving the existing public cron status union.

likelyOwner.reason: Current-main blame and contribution history make steipete the strongest available owner for the cross-cutting cron/session/Discord contract decision.
